q: Who can of Tao the nature tell? Our sight it flies, our touch as well.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao eludes touch
q: Who can of Tao the nature tell? Our sight it flies, our touch as well.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: forms of things reside in Tao (in hidden form)
q: Eluding sight, eluding touch, The forms of things all in it crouch;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: semblances reside in Tao (in hidden form)
q: Eluding touch, eluding sight, There are their semblances, all right.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: essences endure in Tao (profoundly and obscurely)
q: Profound it is, dark and obscure; Things' essences all there endure.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is unchanging old and present (its name passes not away)
q: Now it is so; 'twas so of old. Its name--what passes not away;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: things form beautiful array (without decay)
q: So, in their beautiful array, Things form and never know decay.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: completion becomes complete (when partial)
q: The partial becomes complete;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is free from self-complacency
q: from self-complacency,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is free from striving (such that no one can strive with him)
q: It is because he is thus free from striving that therefore no one in the world is able to strive with him.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: world is unable to strive with sage (no one in it)
q: no one in the world is able to strive with him.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: completion is comprehended under saying (when real)
q: all real completion is comprehended under it.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: desires are few few (for one who gets them)
q: He whose (desires) are few gets them;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: desires are many many (for one who goes astray)
q: he whose (desires) are many goes astray.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage holds in his embrace humility (as the one thing)
q: Therefore the sage holds in his embrace the one thing (of humility),

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage manifests humility (to all the world)
q: and manifests it to all the world.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is free from self-display
q: He is free from self-display,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is free from self-assertion
q: from self-assertion,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is free from self-boasting
q: from self-boasting,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Earth cannot make last spasmodic actings (for a long time)
q: If Heaven and Earth cannot make such (spasmodic) actings last long, how much less can man!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: person making the Tao his business makes Tao (his business)
q: when one is making the Tao his business

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: people pursuing the Tao agree with person making the Tao his business (as to the Tao)
q: those who are also pursuing it, agree with him in it

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: people making the manifestation of the Tao's course their object agree with person making the Tao his business (as to the manifestation of its course)
q: those who are making the manifestation of its course their object agree with him in that

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: people failing to pursue the Tao or manifest its course agree with person making the Tao his business (where they fail)
q: even those who are failing in both these things agree with him where they fail

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: people pursuing the Tao attain happiness of attaining to the Tao (through agreement as to the Tao)
q: those with whom he agrees as to the Tao have the happiness of attaining to it

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: people making the manifestation of the Tao's course their object attain happiness of attaining to the Tao (through agreement as to its manifestation)
q: those with whom he agrees as to its manifestation have the happiness of attaining to it

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: people failing to pursue the Tao or manifest its course attain happiness of attaining to the Tao (through agreement in their failure)
q: those with whom he agrees in their failure have also the happiness of attaining (to the Tao)

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: faith (in the Tao) is not sufficient (on his part)
q: when there is not faith sufficient (on his part)

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: faith (in the Tao) ensues want of faith (in him, when faith is insufficient on his part)
q: when there is not faith sufficient (on his part), a want of faith (in him) ensues (on the part of the others).

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Heaven causes violent wind (together with Earth)
q: To whom is it that these (two) things are owing? To Heaven and Earth.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Earth causes violent wind (together with Heaven)
q: To whom is it that these (two) things are owing? To Heaven and Earth.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Heaven causes sudden rain (together with Earth)
q: To whom is it that these (two) things are owing? To Heaven and Earth.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Earth causes sudden rain (together with Heaven)
q: To whom is it that these (two) things are owing? To Heaven and Earth.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Heaven cannot make last spasmodic actings (for a long time)
q: If Heaven and Earth cannot make such (spasmodic) actings last long, how much less can man!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: person (the one who displays himself, asserts his own views, vaunts himself, or is self-conceited) does not shine not shining (when displaying himself)
q: he who displays himself does not shine;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: those who pursue the course of the Tao do not allow conditions of self-display and self-assertion (as a course of conduct)
q: Hence those who pursue (the course) of the Tao do not adopt and allow them.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: person (the one who displays himself, asserts his own views, vaunts himself, or is self-conceited) is not distinguished not distinguished (when asserting his own views)
q: he who asserts his own views is not distinguished;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: person (the one who displays himself, asserts his own views, vaunts himself, or is self-conceited) has merit unacknowledged merit not acknowledged (when vaunting himself)
q: he who vaunts himself does not find his merit acknowledged;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: person (the one who displays himself, asserts his own views, vaunts himself, or is self-conceited) has no superiority allowed no superiority (when self-conceited)
q: he who is self-conceited has no superiority allowed to him.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: conditions of self-display and self-assertion are like remnants of food (from the standpoint of the Tao)
q: Such conditions, viewed from the standpoint of the Tao, are like remnants of food,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: conditions of self-display and self-assertion are like tumour on the body (from the standpoint of the Tao)
q: Such conditions, viewed from the standpoint of the Tao, are like remnants of food, or a tumour on the body,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: those who pursue the course of the Tao do not adopt conditions of self-display and self-assertion (as a course of conduct)
q: Hence those who pursue (the course) of the Tao do not adopt and allow them.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is a way or course
q: I do not know its name, and I give it the designation of the Tao (the Way or Course).

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is mother of all things (regarded as)
q: It may be regarded as the Mother of all things.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is great great
q: Therefore the Tao is great; Heaven is great; Earth is great; and the (sage) king is also great.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Heaven is great great
q: Therefore the Tao is great; Heaven is great; Earth is great; and the (sage) king is also great.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Earth is great great
q: Therefore the Tao is great; Heaven is great; Earth is great; and the (sage) king is also great.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage king is great great
q: Therefore the Tao is great; Heaven is great; Earth is great; and the (sage) king is also great.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is one of four that are great
q: In the universe there are four that are great, and the (sage) king is one of them.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Heaven is one of four that are great
q: In the universe there are four that are great, and the (sage) king is one of them.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Earth is one of four that are great
q: In the universe there are four that are great, and the (sage) king is one of them.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage king is one of four that are great
q: In the universe there are four that are great, and the (sage) king is one of them.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is undefined undefined
q: There was something undefined and complete, coming into existence before Heaven and Earth.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Man takes law from Earth
q: Man takes his law from the Earth;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Earth takes law from Heaven
q: the Earth takes its law from Heaven;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Heaven takes law from Tao
q: Heaven takes its law from the Tao.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao has law being what it is
q: The law of the Tao is its being what it is.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is complete complete
q: There was something undefined and complete, coming into existence before Heaven and Earth.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is still still
q: How still it was and formless, standing alone, and undergoing no change, reaching everywhere and in no danger (of being exhausted)!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is formless formless
q: How still it was and formless, standing alone, and undergoing no change, reaching everywhere and in no danger (of being exhausted)!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao stands alone alone
q: How still it was and formless, standing alone, and undergoing no change, reaching everywhere and in no danger (of being exhausted)!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao undergoes no change no change
q: How still it was and formless, standing alone, and undergoing no change, reaching everywhere and in no danger (of being exhausted)!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao reaches everywhere
q: How still it was and formless, standing alone, and undergoing no change, reaching everywhere and in no danger (of being exhausted)!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: Tao is not in danger of being exhausted not in danger of being exhausted
q: How still it was and formless, standing alone, and undergoing no change, reaching everywhere and in no danger (of being exhausted)!

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: gravity is root of lightness
q: Gravity is the root of lightness;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: stillness is ruler of movement
q: stillness, the ruler of movement.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: wise prince stays near baggage waggons (while marching the whole day)
q: Therefore a wise prince, marching the whole day, does not go far from his baggage waggons.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: wise prince is indifferent to brilliant prospects (while remaining in his proper place)
q: Although he may have brilliant prospects to look at, he quietly remains (in his proper place), indifferent to them.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: lightness causes loss of gravity (when the lord of a myriad chariots acts lightly before the kingdom)
q: If he do act lightly, he has lost his root (of gravity);

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: movement causes loss of throne (when the lord of a myriad chariots proceeds to active movement)
q: if he proceed to active movement, he will lose his throne.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is skilled at saving men (always)
q: In the same way the sage is always skilful at saving men

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage casts away any man (never)
q: and so he does not cast away any man

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is skilled at saving things (always)
q: he is always skilful at saving things

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage casts away anything (never)
q: and so he does not cast away anything

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is called Hiding the light (of his procedure)
q: This is called 'Hiding the light of his procedure.'

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: man of skill is a master (to be looked up to by person without skill)
q: Therefore the man of skill is a master (to be looked up to) by him who has not the skill

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: person without skill is a helper (of the reputation of man of skill)
q: and he who has not the skill is the helper of (the reputation of) him who has the skill

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage knows manhood's strength
q: Who knows his manhood's strength,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage knows glory (as shining)
q: Who knows how glory shines,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage loves disgrace (without paling for it)
q: Yet loves disgrace, nor e'er for it is pale;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage has presence in a spacious vale
q: Behold his presence in a spacious vale,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: men come to a spacious vale (from all beneath the sky)
q: To which men come from all beneath the sky.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage completes its tale (the unchanging excellence)
q: The unchanging excellence completes its tale;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage embodies man's first state (as the simple infant man)
q: The simple infant man in him we hail.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: the simple child (the sage) is a simple child (free from all stains)
q: The simple child again, free from all stains.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: the unwrought material forms vessels (when divided and distributed)
q: The unwrought material, when divided and distributed, forms vessels.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage becomes the Head of all the Officers (of government) (when employed)
q: The sage, when employed, becomes the Head of all the Officers (of government);

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage maintains female feebleness (still)
q: Yet still his female feebleness maintains;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage receives all (from beneath the sky)
q: All come to him, yea, all beneath the sky.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage retains constant excellence (consistently)
q: Thus he the constant excellence retains;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is free from all stains
q: The simple child again, free from all stains.

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage knows white (as an attracting force)
q: Who knows how white attracts,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage keeps within black (always)
q: Yet always keeps himself within black's shade,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage displays humility (in view of all beneath the sky)
q: The pattern of humility displayed, Displayed in view of all beneath the sky;

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: sage is arrayed in constant excellence (unchangingly)
q: He in the unchanging excellence arrayed,

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: person (the one who would get the kingdom) wishes to get kingdom (for himself)
q: If any one should wish to get the kingdom for himself, and to

l: The Tao Teh King, or The Tao and Its Characteristics
s: strength is spoiled by weakness (often)
q: Strength is of weakness oft the spoil;
